 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The matchups for the first round of the League of Legends 2026 World Championship Swiss Stage are set. This stage of the tournament features fifteen seeded teams and Karmine Corp, who qualified after winning the Worlds 2026 Play-Ins . These teams will compete in a Swiss-system format for a spot in the Knockout Stage.
 The first-round matchups of the Worlds 2026 Swiss Stage are determined by a semi-random draw. Teams are divided into four pools based on the seed they won when they qualified for Worlds. For more information on the format, refer to our Worlds 2026 event guide .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Here are the matchups for the first round of the Swiss Stage:
 Worlds 2026 Swiss Stage Round 1 MatchupsRiot Games
 Gen.G (GEN) vs Invictus Gaming (IG)
 Team Liquid Alienware (TLAW) vs CTBC Flying Oysters (CFO)
 Anyone's Legend (AL) vs Karmine Corp (KC)
 G2 Esports (G2) vs Dplus Kia (DK)
 Hanwha Life Esports (HLE) vs Top Esports
 LOS (LOS) vs T1 (T1)
 Team Secret Whales (TSW) vs LYON (LYON)
 Bilibili Gaming (BLG) vs Movistar KOI (MKOI)
 Right off the bat, the first round of the Worlds 2026 Swiss Stage already features some interesting matchups. The match between the LCK's first seed Gen.G and the LPL's fourth seed Invictus Gaming could be interesting. After underwhelming throughout the middle of the year, Gen.G started picking up steam in the summer. Meanwhile, Invictus Gaming managed to qualify for Worlds again after performing well throughout the LPL's summer playoffs.
 Another match to look forward to is between G2 Esports and Dplus Kia. The two international rivals face each other under the bright lights of Worlds once again. This is also an opportunity for DK to redeem themselves after missing Worlds last year. The LCK's fourth seed is a volatile team, but are a dark horse that shouldn't be underestimated.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement At first glance, the remaining North American teams can be relieved that they have relatively easy first round matchups. Both teams will face the remaining Asia-Pacific teams, CTBC Flying Oyster and Team Secret Whales. However, the LCP has shown they have what it takes to win games off stronger regions. Both Team Liquid Alienware and LYON have to bring their A game to avoid getting upset.
 The Swiss Stage of Worlds 2026 will begin on Friday, October 23 at 12 PM CDT.
